Technicians Hansraj and Aayush were polite and professional, and they thoroughly sprayed all areas including the washing machine trolley. I kept the house closed for six hours as advised.

However, I still found live bed bugs inside and around the trolley area, which raises concerns about the effectiveness of the medicine used. The staff did their job sincerely, but the overall treatment result has not been satisfactory.
